content.text: [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/digital-product-stores-kyc-payments-what-actually-how-2|Digital Product]] creators in countries like Nigeria, Ghana, and Venezuela often struggle with Stripe, PayPal, or Gumroad restrictions, hindering their ability to collect crypto payments. COREMERCH offers a sovereign commerce infrastructure that allows these creators to deploy a digital store with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership. In this guide, we'll focus on [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/deploying-digital-store-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-workers-crypto-payment-webhooks-explained-digital-creators-7|COREMERCH guide to cloudflare]]-pages-free-step-step-10|deploying]] Supabase as the order database for digital stores, a crucial component of COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack ($197), which is deployed in 48 hours and end-to-end tested before handoff. This infrastructure sovereignty empowers digital creators to own their data and processes, eliminating reliance on restricted platforms.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Stack 01 — the Sovereign Starter Stack — uses GitHub Pages for storefront hosting, Google Apps Script as the backend Web App, Google Sheets as the order database, Google Drive for product file storage, and Gmail for delivery email. The entire stack costs nothing per month. Google Apps Script runs in response to webhook events from NOWPayments, validates the payment, logs the order to Google Sheets, generates a receipt, and sends a Gmail delivery email with a Google Drive shared link. The daily limits on the free tier are adequate for most creators at the early and growth stages.
What You Need Before You Deploy

To deploy Supabase as the order database for your digital store, you'll need to have a GitHub account, as Supabase is hosted on GitHub Pages. Additionally, you'll need to create a NOWPayments account and configure your payment settings. Lastly, ensure you have a Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) or Edge Commerce Stack ($197) subscription, which includes access to the necessary infrastructure components.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

The NOWPayments configuration sequence is the same regardless of which stack you are deploying. Create a NOWPayments account — no KYC required, no document upload, no bank account needed. Navigate to the wallet settings and add the wallet addresses for each cryptocurrency you want to accept. USDT on Tron and Bitcoin are the practical starting point for most creators in restricted markets. Generate an API key from the NOWPayments dashboard. Set the webhook endpoint URL in the NOWPayments IPN settings pointing to your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App. Set the webhook secret key — a string you generate that both NOWPayments and your backend know.
Supabase provides a scalable and secure order database for digital stores.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Testing before promotion is not optional — it is the step that determines whether your store functions correctly under real conditions before real buyers encounter it. The test sequence has four steps. First: deploy the backend and confirm the webhook endpoint returns a valid response to a test HTTP POST. Second: configure the storefront and confirm the checkout displays correctly on desktop and mobile. Third: complete a real mainnet transaction with a small amount of actual crypto. Fourth: check your order database and confirm the order was logged correctly, the delivery email arrived, and the download link works.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

The post-deployment ownership transfer is explicit in every COREMERCH deployment. When the build is complete and the end-to-end test passes, COREMERCH provides the credentials and configuration details for every component under the customer's accounts. The GitHub or Cloudflare repository is under the customer's account from the start. The Supabase or Google Sheets database is under the customer's account. The NOWPayments account is under the customer's email. COREMERCH removes collaborator access upon delivery. From that point, the store runs entirely under the customer's own accounts.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

The most important question a reader would ask is, 'Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?' The answer is yes, with COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure, you can deploy a digital store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, eliminating the need for Stripe or PayPal restrictions. This infrastructure sovereignty empowers digital creators to own their data and processes, allowing them to scale and grow their businesses without relying on restricted platforms.
NOWPayments offers automatic on-chain payment verification for digital stores.

Additionally, you can explore other related searches, such as github pages digital store crypto payments free hosting or cloudflare pages workers supabase nowpayments stack.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy Supabase as the order database for your digital store, follow these concrete steps: Deploy your Supabase instance using the Sovereign Blueprint, which takes approximately 4-6 hours. Configure your NOWPayments account to integrate with Supabase, enabling automatic on-chain payment verification. Set up your Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 account for instant file delivery. Deploy your Edge Commerce Stack ($197) in 48 hours, which includes end-to-end testing before handoff. Configure your SPF/DKIM/DMARC settings to ensure secure email delivery. Test your payment and delivery pipeline by processing a mock transaction.
